nick_sales: Quick Atlas POC load summary. Ran the mixed profile they requested. Topline: sustained 160 qps with scheduled 20s microbursts to 420 qps. Observed p95=225ms, p99=1.35s, max ~3.1s, errors ~0.8% (mostly long-gen timeouts). Customer asks: 1) small reserved burst pricing delta, 2) BYOK/KMS notes + questionnaire, 3) why autoscale lagged.

tara_se: please paste the load command and mix. was embedding batching or KV cache enabled?

nick_sales: run (via benchbot):

```
benchbot run --target https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\\
  --concurrency 160 --duration 600 \\\
  --schedule "soak:160:600,burst:420:20@300s" \\\
  --mix "chat_short:0.65,embed_512:0.25,long_gen:0.1" \\\
  --model redwood/gptx-7b:v2-int8 --region us-west-2
```

KV cache: ON for chat. Embedding batching: OFF for baseline.

benchbot: run_complete id=atlas-2026-05-25 summary: qps=160 avg=130ms p95=225ms p99=1350ms max=3120ms errors=0.8% (long_gen_timeouts) link=https://internal.runs/atlas-2026-05-25.json

ben_infra: quick infra read: autoscaler saw spike and requested nodes at t+34s; vGPUs attached at t+125s due to allocation delays in this region's dedicated pool. Short burst window + cold attach explains the tail. Also saw CPU queuing on embedding proxy since batching was off.

tara_se: mitigation notes: 1) enable adaptive embedding batching (20-30ms window), 2) increase burst_window_secs to 180-240s so autoscaler can fully attach, 3) prewarm_nodes=1 before scheduled bursts, 4) raise long-gen timeout to 12s to reduce client-side errors. Example config snippet: {"adaptive_batching":"true","embedding_batch_ms":"25","burst_window_secs":"180","prewarm_nodes":"1","request_timeout_secs":"12"}.

ron_product: Atlas requires p95 < 300ms and p99 < 1s for short chat. They also require BYOK with HSM-backed CMK and SAML SSO notes. I'll take the security questionnaire. We support BYOK via our KMS bridge; KMS flow diagram and signed attestation will follow.

nick_sales: sales action: can infra give a quick ballpark for a 2-node reserved burst pool (assumption: nodes sized for long-gen) and expected monthly delta vs hosted-only? Need numbers for the Tuesday exec call.

ben_infra: rough back-of-envelope: 2 vGPU nodes reserved in us-west-2 ~ $3,300/month commit. Expected per-token reduction for long-gen when served on reserved nodes ~20-25%, and tail should improve substantially. Ballpark combined delta vs hosted-only for this profile ~ +$1,700/month. I'll engage finance for formal quote.

tara_se: I'll PR a short runbook with the config change and a how-to for prewarm + embedding batching. Will verify with a follow-up run tomorrow and post results.

benchbot: marker: run_id=atlas-2026-05-25 results_uploaded

nick_sales: thanks team. Action items recap: tara -> runbook + verification run; ben -> autoscale event logs + finance reserved quote; ron -> security Q + KMS diagram; sales -> draft 1-page delta for customer meeting. Will update Atlas after we have infra logs and pricing. :thumbsup:
